worldcombat.skill.mudslap.summary: Hurl a fistful of wet mud in the target's face. The damage is light, but its accuracy always drops.
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.use.0: Open at close-to-mid range with a guaranteed accuracy drop
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.use.1: Set up the next big move
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.description.0: Splat the mud in the target's face: %1$s special damage and a guaranteed %2$s stage accuracy drop.
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.description.1: The clod flies a low arc at %1$s, up to %2$s blocks, with a %3$s block hit radius, steering up to %4$s degrees per tick.
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.mudslap.preference.thi: On: clod power ×1.18 and one more accuracy stage, but throw speed ×0.82, +4 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown. Off: thrown faster with a shorter wind-up, at the base stage count.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values open at longer range.
On: it may leave a hold position to throw. Off: it only throws when already in range.
